QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_26

question.text: When does reallocation occur under the NPS Auto Choice lifecycle funds?

answer.text: On the last day of the financial year
On the first working day of each quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Auto Choice, the portfolio is reallocated automatically on the subscriber's birthday in line with the selected lifecycle fund's glide path, so the asset mix shifts gradually with the subscriber's age. The Trap: Calendar dates such as January 1, the last day of the financial year, or the first working day of a quarter are not used. Reallocation is personalised to each subscriber's birthday. Note: Stem rewritten from "At what age" to "When" so it correctly asks about a timing event.
